text:
A narrow beam of light consists of two waves of different wavelengths.
The beam of light hits a sharp edge.
Which effect will be seen beyond the sharp edge?
A
Both waves continue along the same straight line as before.
B
Both waves bend sharply and continue along a new straight line.
C
The wave of longer wavelength bends round the sharp edge more than the wave of shorter
wavelength.
D
The wave of shorter wavelength bends round the sharp edge more than the wave of longer
wavelength.
